name: Touchwood Entertainment Ltd
about:

Business Overview:[1]
TEL is India’s first NSE Listed event management company. It specializes in Wedding and Event Management for bespoke & luxury weddings and celebrations. Company curates and executes bespoke event experiences for  Destinations within India and Internationally
